Upstream's vendored min2phase.js and OrbitControls.js carry no licence or attribution header, and the repo ships neither cubing/min2phase.js's LICENSE.md nor three.js's MIT notice. Rouxtine must add the MIT notices (Lucas Garron 2018 / Chen Shuang 2023 / three.js authors) itself. Sources: https://github.com/onionhoney/roux-trainers/tree/0129460a5c30082ea0e29b4489623889118078ec/src/lib/min2phase , https://github.com/cubing/min2phase.js/blob/a465b5e458fc1850299cab3c6254973c7f4c76ae/LICENSE.md

cubing/min2phase.js calls itself 'A JS package for Chen Shuang's ... min2phase', and its src/min2phase.js is a JS translation of Chen's Java. Garron's 2018 MIT option rests on Chen's authorship, so port from cs0x7f/min2phase and cite Chen's own 2023 'License MIT' section. Sources: https://github.com/cubing/min2phase.js/blob/a465b5e458fc1850299cab3c6254973c7f4c76ae/README.md , https://github.com/cs0x7f/min2phase/blob/4d183b9eff8119cac72bc50ef35a7d8990740e06/README.md

Tasks.org is also a precedent for Option G and for GitHub Sponsors as the non-Play payment rail. Play builds sell the hosted sync subscription through Play Billing. Generic/F-Droid builds keep a donation nag, and SignInActivity says 'A GitHub sponsorship is required to use Tasks.org sync' (https://github.com/sponsors/abaker). The googleplay flavour also bundles PostHog analytics. Sources: https://github.com/tasks/tasks/blob/4d7792727f1a96c92410fa00665a5e657681600f/app/src/main/java/org/tasks/auth/SignInActivity.kt , https://github.com/tasks/tasks/blob/4d7792727f1a96c92410fa00665a5e657681600f/app/build.gradle.kts#L288-L306

Mullvad's README says its App Store build 'is not GPL licensed, it falls under the Apple App Store EULA'. Its CONTRIBUTING takes only a GPL-3.0 grant from contributors. This is an explicit case of a copyright-holder distributor relying on ownership rather than a written exception. Sources: https://github.com/mullvad/mullvadvpn-app/blob/main/README.md , https://github.com/mullvad/mullvadvpn-app/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

Inbound-licence precedents for CONTRIBUTING: DAVx5 (CLA bot), linphone (Belledonne Contributor Agreement PDF, which enables dual licensing), ics-openvpn (CLA, plus 'If you need a non GPLv2 license of the source please contact me'), and Terpoir (DCO + 'Contributions are accepted under the same terms, including the additional permissions'). Sources: https://github.com/bitfireAT/davx5-ose/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md , https://github.com/BelledonneCommunications/linphone-android/blob/master/README.md , https://github.com/schwabe/ics-openvpn/blob/master/doc/LICENSE.txt , https://github.com/nolsen311/Terpoir/blob/main/LICENSING.md

Terpoir also carries a broader 'Application stores' s.7 permission covering store terms that are incompatible with the GPL, provided the source is available elsewhere. It tags files 'GPL-3.0-or-later WITH AdditionRef-Terpoir-AppStore-exception'. It is a pre-development project whose seed commit is authored 'Claude', so its wording is not lawyer-vetted. Source: https://github.com/nolsen311/Terpoir/blob/main/LICENSING.md
